category_title: Young children with SEBD, communication difficulties, and short attention spans
scenario_title: Verbally mediated feedback and expression tasks
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group feedback session and is asked to verbally explain the poster they designed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the poster you made with the group. Can you tell me your thoughts about what you drew?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I feel happy because I play and do crafts. We play and eat and do nice things. I feel happy.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That's good. What else can you say about the pictures on your poster?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It was fun. I liked the drawing and working together. There is a bus and breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you explain your feelings about the bus and going to the mainstream class?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Fidgets with the pens and looks away from the poster) I don't know... it's just nice. (Struggles to find words, gets up from the chair, and starts wandering away from the group activity)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at the poster you made with the group. Can you tell me your thoughts about what you drew?

STUDENT: I feel happy because I play and do crafts. We play and eat and do nice things. I feel happy.

TUTOR: That's good. What else can you say about the pictures on your poster?

STUDENT: It was fun. I liked the drawing and working together. There is a bus and breakfast.

TUTOR: Can you explain your feelings about the bus and going to the mainstream class?

STUDENT: (Fidgets with the pens and looks away from the poster) I don't know... it's just nice. (Struggles to find words, gets up from the chair, and starts wandering away from the group activity)

task.content: Participating in semi-structured group interviews and feedback sessions that required verbal responses

context.materials: A3 sheets, magazines, pens, glue, scissors, drawings, pictures, and posters
context.time_context: During the collaborative mapping activity and poster design

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: In two of the more verbally mediated tasks in the study when asked to verbalise their thoughts and feelings
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Found it difficult to express themselves, showed limited verbal expression, short attention span, and restlessness

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Limited in verbal expression, short attention span, restlessness
